messages:
incident-bot: PAGER - P1 alert: dedicated-pool eu-west-1 high concurrency spike >5x baseline, 5xx rate rising. Pager: alex (oncall)

alex (oncall): I'm on it. seeing sustained qps spike from a few customers, errors ~3% and queue depth creeping. UI shows pool saturation and no new workers coming up.

emma (sre): checking autoscaler logs — looks like scale-up blocked by burst quota config: 'burst_allowed=false' for eu-west-1 after last safety patch. also seeing a throttling rule for non-enterprise orgs.

sarah (runtime): can we enable burst temporarily while we stabilize? plan: enable burst for 10m, apply coarse rate caps for best-effort customers, leave enterprise customers unthrottled.

alex (oncall): +1. execute in this order: 1) enable burst 2) apply temporary rate-limit policy to non-enterprise routes 3) bump quota for impacted enterprise orgs. mike, can you flip the toggle? i'll coordinate customer comms.

mike (infra): flipping now. running admin command: 
```
/api-admin toggle-burst --pool eu-west-1 --enable true --duration 10m --reason "P1 autoscale blocked; temp enable to shed queue"
```

mike (infra): response: 200 OK - burst_enabled=true, burst_window=10m, max_additional_instances=8 :white_check_mark:

alex (oncall): applying rate caps for best-effort tier (20rps per org) and prioritizing enterprise routes. command: 
```
POST /ops/ratelimit
{ "scope": "non-enterprise", "limit_rps": 20, "duration": 600 }
```

alex (oncall): applied. logs: rate-limit rules attached to route /v1/generate and /v1/chat.

josh (support): notified affected customers on pager channel: AcmeCorp (org-432) and NovaApps (org-874). Acme reported elevated latency, Nova seeing timeouts. Both acknowledged incident comms.

lina (acct): bumped AcmeCorp quota to 2x for the next 30 minutes (org override). NovaApps flagged as lower tier — keeping rate-limited.

emma (sre): metrics update: within 90s of burst toggle, tail latency (95p) for eu-west pool dropped from ~720ms -> ~210ms. 5xx dropped from 3% -> 0.4%. queue depth decreasing.

sarah (runtime): good. recommendation: keep burst on for 15m to let autoscaler catch up, then gradually roll burst down. also enable model-fallback for best-effort customers so they get smaller model variant instead of errors. I'll land a short config: model_fallback=enabled for non-enterprise.

alex (oncall): handoff: emma will take over active monitoring in 30m. if errors spike back above 1% or latency climbs, revert burst and tighten rate-limits. emma, confirm you can take over at 4311112540.

emma (sre): confirmed, I'll take the handoff and keep monitoring dashboards + alert on 5xx>1% or tail latency >500ms.

mike (infra): audit log entry: toggle-burst by mike @4311112235, rules-applied by alex @4311112240. snapshot of pool state saved to s3://redwood-ops/audit/4311112235-burst-enable.json

alex (oncall): quick health check note for runbook: 1) burst enabled 2) non-enterprise rate limit = 20rps 3) Acme quota override active 4) model fallback enabled for best-effort.

josh (support): updating public incident note: "We temporarily enabled emergency burst capacity in eu-west to mitigate service degradation; rate limits applied to non-enterprise customers. Some customers may see reduced model fidelity." posting now.

sarah (runtime): after stabilization we should change autoscaler policy to avoid future block: current quota gate is too strict for sudden bursts. I'll open a PR for autoscale policy tweak with a safety override for short bursts.

emma (sre): observed stable metrics for last 4m, continuing to watch. will escalate if any regression. handing off to me in 30m.

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: burst_toggle(executed)=true by mike at 4311112235; rate_limit_policy(created)=non-enterprise-20rps by alex at 4311112240; quota_override(org-432)=2x by lina at 4311112252; handoff scheduled to emma at 4311112540.

alex (oncall): thanks team. leaving channel, monitoring until handoff. :thumbsup:

emma (sre): oncall notes appended to incident tracker. next steps after handoff: review autoscale decision path, add a guard to avoid full disable of burst without emergency override, and follow up with product on tiering impact.

alex (oncall): closing my active pager. last update timestamp 4311112300."
